podcast.body: Mike Skinner's second album, released in May 2004, chronicles the everyday activities of a regular British guy experiencing a series of unfortunate events. Each song acts as a chapter in the protagonist's quest to find a mysteriously disappeared thousand pounds. Throughout the narrative, he breaks up with his girlfriend (who is cheating with his friend), struggles with excessive drinking and drug use, quarrels with a TV repairman, and ultimately discovers the missing money hidden inside his TV set. "And it basically tells of the everyday activities of a regular British guy."

podcast.body: This 2004 album by The Streets had a significant impact on Alex Turner, more so than their previous work. It is described as a concept album chronicling the adventures of a protagonist who loses a thousand pounds and spends the entire record attempting to recover it. The lyrics are noted for being observational, conversational, and colloquial.
